slot.brief: A combustion reaction at a given temperature with known ΔU or ΔH; use the gas stoichiometry to convert between ΔH and ΔU.

stem: For $\text{CH}_4(g)+2\text{O}_2(g)\rightarrow\text{CO}_2(g)+2\text{H}_2\text{O}(l)$ at $300\ \text{K}$, $\Delta U=-800.0\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$. Find $\Delta H$. Take $R=8.00\ \text{J K}^{-1}\text{mol}^{-1}$.
working:
$\Delta n_g=1-(1+2)=-2$
$\Delta H=\Delta U+\Delta n_gRT$
$=-800.0+\dfrac{(-2)(8.00)(300)}{1000}$
$=-804.8\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$

Independent check: \(\Delta n_g=1-3=-2\). Thus \(\Delta H=\Delta U+\Delta n_gRT=-800.0+(-2)(8.00)(300)/1000=-804.8\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}\).
